description: Make throwaway email addresses with Guerrilla Mail, ready in a second with no sign-up. Create an inbox with a random name or one you choose, wait for a confirmation email to arrive, read it in full, list and delete emails, and keep the inbox for another hour or forget it when you are done. Handy for testing sign-up and password-reset emails, or for keeping your own address out of a form. Inboxes are public and email is deleted after an hour, so don't use them for anything private. No account or API key required.
